_comment: Opening cards that do not carry one of the four beats checkStory.mjs looks for (what has happened, the job as authority, what the fortnight has to end with, what it costs). A campaign whose opening copy is fixed by a source document says it in words the rule cannot see, or does not say it at all. Same ratchet as the other debt files here: a gap not listed fails now, and a listed gap that has since been written fails too, naming the line to delete.
